method: OpenSees Linear -jntOffset; global analytical offsets in metres, SI output; independent cantilever closed-form plus global stiffness and node equilibrium checks

inputs.section_source: Explicit synthetic A and Iz; not actual project sections

limitations: 2D small-displacement linear Euler-Bernoulli elasticity only
No shear deformation, geometric stiffness, buckling, nonlinear or dynamic analysis
Rigid joints and fixed bases are explicit verification assumptions
No actual platform-wide mapping, foundation or connection capacity analysis
IS/US design checks and engineering approval disabled

independent_reference.formulation: Independent 2D EA/L and EI Euler-Bernoulli 6x6 stiffness assembly, transformed to global axes; Kff uf = Ff, R = Ku - F

reference.formula: Mphysical=ry Fx-rx Fy; theta=Fy L²/(2EI)+Mphysical L/EI; uxphysical=Fx L/EA; uyphysical=Fy L³/(3EI)+Mphysical L²/(2EI); umaster=uphysical+[ry theta,-rx theta]; Rm=-[(L-rx)Fy+ry Fx]
reference.sources: Explicit synthetic verification loads Fx=1000 N, Fy=-2000 N; E=200 GPa, A=0.01 m², I=8e-6 m⁴; fixed support, Euler-Bernoulli, massless rigid end offset, not physical connection capacity
